args.title: Support rupee signs and apostrophe separators in parseAmount
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

Update parseAmount in src/util/money.ts to remove other currency symbols or letters/signs such as ₹ and apostrophes/thousands separators so that amounts like ₹1,250.00 and CHF 1'200.00 are successfully parsed.

label: bug
file: src/util/money.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The money parsing utility uses a regex replacement that fails to strip currency symbols like rupee signs (₹) and apostrophes used as thousands separators (such as in CHF 1'200.00). Updating parseAmount in src/util/money.ts to handle these additional characters will allow such amounts to be successfully validated and parsed.
